say:1:1037036001:0.text: I was worried that rumors and gossip would spread, but it seems that I was overthinking it.
say:1:1037036001:0.source_cn: 我之前还担心传闻和流言会发酵，但那好像都是我想多了。

say:2:1037036002:0.text: It seemed like a terrible nightmare, and now everything has returned to normal.
say:2:1037036002:0.source_cn: 大家好像做了一个可怕的噩梦，现在一切都回归平静。

say:3:1037036003:0.text: This is all thanks to the Wilders from Dark Forest and, of course, you as well.
say:3:1037036003:0.source_cn: 这些都要归功于薄暮丛林来的那些绿裔联盟同胞，当然，还有你。
say:3:1037036003:0.male: This is all thanks to the Wilders from Dark Forest and, of course, you as well.
say:3:1037036003:0.female: This is all thanks to the Wilders from Dark Forest and, of course, you as well.

say:4:1037036004:1.text: I would like to express my gratitude on behalf of Ivoryshade.
say:4:1037036004:1.source_cn: 我代替月影乡向你表示感谢。
say:4:1037036004:1.male: I would like to express my gratitude on behalf of Ivoryshade.
say:4:1037036004:1.female: I would like to express my gratitude on behalf of Ivoryshade.
